_meta.what: Per-op communication primitives and per-topology per-layer comm lists for the K3.1-Pro VR200 SOL model. Companion of topologies.md (same ids/sections).
_meta.units: bytes per GPU over NVLink per collective call (in_B = received, out_B = sent), hops = dependent NVLink handoffs. Cost (hw.md sec.4): t = hops*2.9e-6 + max(in_B,out_B)/1.25e12 s (SOL 1.8e12).
_meta.formula_syntax: Python expressions over the variables in 'variables' and 'constants'; sums over requests written as sum_C (sum of context lengths of the step's requests).
sources: Inferact/nvidia-vllm-agentx PR #20 and #23 (ops/dsa_dp.py, ops/sp_local_aux.py, model.py, dsa.py, gqa_draft.py diffs)

variables.N: TP group size (heads/columns sharded); W = DCP size (= N in all shipped configs); D = DP size; E = EP size (= D*N with MegaMoE)
variables.T: rows of the step on one TP group (prefill: fresh tokens; decode: R = B*q)
variables.n: rows per rank under SP = ceil(T/N)
variables.m: rows entering the MoE on this rank (T/N under SP or token shard, T under DEP, R under DEP decode)
variables.sum_C: sum over the step's requests of context length (prefix+new)
variables.T_o: rows owned by DSA-DP owner card o
variables.imb: MoE max/mean routes per rank (EPLB imbalance), >= 1
variables.X_topk: DcpExchange bytes per row per peer, ~1000-2000 (inferred, see topologies.md sec.10)

TP.desc: TP-N, replicated residual (no SP). Used: P/D prefill TP8+DCP8 (DP1, EP8, MoE token shard); TP16+DCP16 decode (MoE TP, specialized decode).

dsa.note: without any: replicated DSA KV + replicated indexer, local heads padded to the kernel tile

moe_tp_no_ep.op: tail latent AR + shared RS + out AG

embedding.primitive: P1 (or owner publish in sdec TP16)

replicated_compute: w/o ShardQ/DCP/DSA-DP: indexer scoring T*C*32*128 + top-k + MLA/indexer KV insert
stock plain-TP MoE: router + latent down/up on all rows

TP_SP.desc: TP-N with sequence parallelism (EP, TP>1, PP1, MegaMoE or DP>1, not token shard). Used: C512 hybrid P and D; DSA-DP layouts.

moe.note: m = n; router, latent, shared expert replicated weights on own rows, no TP collective

dense_mlp_layer0.note: VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT=1 shards it with own AG+RS

final.note: PR#20: SP-local aux for eager steps >= 4096 rows

replicated_compute: attention replication as TP (all T rows after AG)

DCP_decode.desc: DCP W=N (interleave 1: token t on rank t mod W), DSA decode. Specialized decode path (sdec) and stock MLADCPManager.

per_dsa_layer.op: q publish (FP8 MQA query, own heads to all ranks)
output combine (W_UV first, value rows to head owners, LSE merge)

replicated_compute: W_UV over all 96 heads on every rank (proj)
new-token MLA/indexer rows computed on every rank, stored by owner

DCP_ShardQ_prefill.desc: DCP=TP prefill steps as ShardQ over a gathered context (dcp_shardq_configured, dcp.py:1086). ~100% of prefill tokens in TP8+DCP8 and DP4x(TP4+DCP4) logs.

per_dsa_layer.op: context push (MLA 576 + indexer 68 B/token of every request in the step, plus new-token indexer rows)
q scatter heads->token slice, bf16 192-dim before W_UK
value gather token slice->heads, bf16 128-dim after W_UV

notes: no top-k merge and no LSE combine
row split fold_split: 2W pieces per request, rank r owns r and 2W-1-r
workspace ~0.7 GB per 1M context tokens per rank
example T=16K, sum_C=130K, W=8: context 73 MB, q 64.5 MB, out 43 MB, o_proj AR 235 MB
replicated_compute: kv_a (fused_qkv_a) and MLA KV rows for all new tokens on every rank

TP_ShardQ_or_indexer_split.desc: TP without DCP, replicated DSA KV (PR#20 commit 2): VLLM_K3_TP_SHARDQ=1 ShardQ on replicated KV; default 'indexer split' scores T/N rows and all-gathers top-k.

HYBRID_DPxTP_DCP_EP.desc: C512: DP4 x (TP4 = DCP4 = SP4), EP16 MegaMoE (kimi_k3_mega_moe), fp8 KV + mxfp4 indexer, interleave 1, dcp-comm-backend a2a. P MNBT 32768; D MNBT 8192, max-num-seqs 128/rank.
HYBRID_DPxTP_DCP_EP.composition: TP_SP inside each TP4 group + DCP_decode (D) / DCP_ShardQ_prefill (P) on the TP4 group + MegaMoE EP over all 16 GPUs
cross_dp: P19 DP token sync; EP lock-step bucket at DP max (padding)

anchors.prefill: ~13K-token steps, >=165 ms + 11 ms/1K tokens; 4.34 req/s per DP4 engine

DEP.desc: DP attention + EP MoE, TP=1: all attention/KDA/projections local per request; MegaMoE EP over all ranks.
notes: dense weights fully replicated (~113 GB/GPU) -> weight-bound at small decode batch
DEP.kv_per_gpu_per_req: dsa_kv_B_per_tok*C + KDA + SWA + RecoverSSM (all on one GPU)

DSA_DP.desc: TP for GEMMs/KDA/MoE; each request owned by one card of the TP group for DSA layers (VLLM_K3_TP_DSA_DP=1, TP>1, DCP=1). PR#20 prefill, PR#23 decode + P/D.
DSA_DP.code: PR#20 ops/dsa_dp.py, model.py _run_dsa_dp/_dsa_scatter, dsa.py local_full_heads, v1/core/dsa_dp_regions.py; PR#23 dsa_dp.py dep_order/DepPerm/_lamport_exchange

per_dsa_layer_sp.op: push_out owner outputs to shard owners

per_dsa_layer_decode.op: Lamport push in/out, DEP-ordered segments padded to busiest owner
per_dsa_layer_decode.note: padding factor N*max_o(B_o)/B; graph sizes multiples of N*q

DSA_DP.replicated_weights: DSA 480 MB/layer BF16 on every card (11.5 GB)
DSA_DP.kv: DSA + indexer KV in owner's static region (one copy per TP group); KDA, drafter SWA in shared pool (/N)
DSA_DP.pd: P exports remote_dsa_owner=o; D owner = o*tp_D/tp_P; NIXL DSA groups only owner<-P rank o; pairs TP4->TP4, TP4->TP1(DEP)

MoE_EP_vs_TP.quant_kind: Rubin MegaMoE: mxfp4_mxfp8 up to 512 tokens/rank, else exact MXFP4->NVFP4 weights with NVFP4 activations (experts.py:145); logs: TP8 prefill EP8 nvfp4 bucket 2048, C512 prefill EP16 nvfp4 bucket 8192
MoE_EP_vs_TP.die_local: decode only: experts homed per die (17.1 vs 13.9 TB/s); no comm change (die_local.py)

TP.lm_head: vocab/N + P16 Markov key exchange per draft position
TP.measured: ~13 us per stock fused site at TP16 B1

SP.aux: final AG [hidden|5 aux] 6h wide (P18) or PR#20 SP-local aux: fc on own shard + AG [n,h]

DEP.weights: ~5 GB full drafter + full LM head/embedding per GPU

DSA_DP.placement: every card (TP); SWA KV in shared pool, kv heads /N (gqa_draft.py _dsa_dp_kv)

DSA_DP.dsa: owner only (avg /N; static per-card region -> owner skew wastes capacity)

kv_capacity.caveat: hybrid KV manager packs KDA state pages, attention pages and SWA slots into one page pool (v1/core/kv_cache_utils); logged 'GPU KV cache size' tokens: TP16+DCP16 D 56.5M/engine, TP8+DCP8 P 10.8M, C512 D 19.3M per DP engine, C512 P 16.9M

new_strategies.name: DSA-DP + split indexer
new_strategies.effect: removes owner indexer hotspot at long context; MLA KV one copy

new_strategies.name: DCP only for DSA layers (DSA-CP) over group G, DEP/TP elsewhere
new_strategies.effect: DSA KV /G; pays when DSA KV capacity binds

new_strategies.name: Prefill CP over cached prefix: query shipping vs context gather
new_strategies.crossover: T/C ~ 644/(84e3*W) (~1/1000 at W=8): prefill keeps context gather, decode ships queries

new_strategies.name: Pipeline / layer split over NVL72
new_strategies.effect: weights and KV per GPU /S; bubbles; candidate for prefill with DEP inside a stage

new_strategies.name: MoE dispatch dedup per destination rank + in-rank pre-combine
new_strategies.precision: FP32 per-rank partial then one BF16 rounding: reorder vs stock per-route BF16 + TopkReduce; needs sign-off

new_strategies.name: Mixed parallel degree per layer type (SP over G, KDA TP-N_k, DSA DSA-DP/DCP in subgroup, MoE EP over G/rack)
new_strategies.comm: as TP_SP/DSA_DP with N=N_k; no resharding
new_strategies.effect: C512 layout is G=16, N_k=4 special case

new_strategies.name: Attention-DP + GEMM-TP for KDA (owner KDA core)
new_strategies.verdict: worse than head-parallel KDA; recorded to close the option

new_strategies.name: Sequence-parallel KDA (chunk scan across ranks)
new_strategies.comm: log2(N) rounds of 96/N_h*128*128*4 B per layer per request

new_strategies.name: Two-microbatch overlap of SP/DSA-DP/EP comm
new_strategies.constraint: use_ubatching excludes DCP ShardQ; MegaMoE lock-step

new_strategies.name: Quantize-at-source where the consumer quantizes anyway
new_strategies.rule: no lossy compression of BF16 activations

new_strategies.name: Expert placement: rack-wide EP (EP72), EPLB redundancy, die-local
Drafter placement: TP4 drafter under TP16 target, or drafter-DP
new_strategies.crossover: 5e9/13.9e12 s weight stream vs 11*AR(R_d*14336, N) per draft forward

new_strategies.name: Indexer-only DCP (shard 68 B/token indexer keys widely, MLA owned/replicated)
new_strategies.effect: O(C) indexer scan scales with group, MLA traffic unchanged
